_why: Local Codex session logs cover 6,872 rollout files across two directories (~/.codex/sessions and ~/.codex/archived_sessions, session IDs disjoint, both merged by scripts/merge_scans.py).
Those logs account for 28.06B tokens of real, per-message, per-day data = 96.53% of what OpenAI reports for the account.
The remaining 3.47% has no local source left to match against - those sessions were pruned before they were ever scanned, and the provider exposes no per-day API to recover them.
So: the daily curve is measured, and the 1.01B residual is spread across days in proportion to measured activity. It is a rounding correction on top of real data, not a fabricated shape.
